title: Instant Copper Oxidizer
description:
Instantly oxidise any copper block with flint and steel, no waiting required.
Part of the Murf Tweaks package mod.
body:
**Instant Copper Oxidiser allows players to instantly oxidise any unwaxed copper block by shift-right-clicking it with a flint and steel.**

The mod is designed to work entirely server-side. The implementation is significantly smoother if the client also has the mod installed, however functionally there is no difference.
